title: 香蕉棒球Jesse Cole：世界渴望快乐，球员后空翻接球引爆四万人现场
speaker: Jesse Cole

segments.en: Yeah, I mean I think you know right now more than ever the world is hungry for fun the hungry for joy. And you know, we don't take ourselves too seriously and the ball in the field is unbelievable these players are
segments.zh: 是的，我认为现在世界比以往任何时候都渴望乐趣、渴望快乐。我们不把自己太当回事，场上的球技令人难以置信，这些球员……

segments.en: Unbelievably talented. I mean they're doing backflip catches and they're doing catches between the legs. They're hitting 400-foot home runs but also they understand it's about entertainment and putting on a show
segments.zh: 天赋惊人。他们做后空翻接球，做胯下接球，打出400英尺的全垒打，但他们也明白这是娱乐，是一场表演。

segments.en: So they'll come and do a walk-up dance. They'll do a celebration. That's fun. And I think you know the world needs that and you know, it's a balance. You know that there's baseball which is a great game
segments.zh: 他们会跳上场舞，会庆祝，这很有趣。我认为世界需要这个，这是一种平衡。棒球本身是伟大的运动。

segments.en: We're so grateful to have some great ball players. But we know that we got to entertain in the crowd and with 40,000 fans here tonight. You know, we're gonna have all of our players up in the upper deck entertaining the crowd and it's just about breaking down
segments.zh: 我们很感激有一些伟大的球员。但我们知道必须在观众中娱乐，今晚有四万粉丝。我们所有球员都会到上层看台娱乐观众，就是要打破……

segments.en: That barrier between fans and players and giving fans something they've never seen before never felt before at a stadium. That's what brings us joy every single night
segments.zh: 球迷和球员之间的隔阂，给球迷在体育场从未见过、从未感受过的东西。这就是每晚带给我们快乐的事。
